## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Barcelona, Spain. It starts at Mount Montjuic Cable Car, 30,Avinguda Miramar, Barcelona. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Round trip ticket to Montjuic Cable Car.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Experience Barcelona like never before with Montjuïc Cable Car tickets! This exciting journey will take you on a scenic 750-meter ride from Parc de Montjuic to the top of Montjuïc Hill. Along the way, you'll enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city and its surroundings, making for a truly unforgettable experience.
>
> Mount Montjuïc has a special significance for the city of Barcelona. With an elevation of 173 meters, it is slightly higher than any building constructed in the city. Even Gaudi’s Sagrada Familia will stay just below this. The hill is a home for several famous museums including Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya and Fundació Joan Miró.
>
> Taking a cable car, you will arrive at the stunning Castell de Montjuïc, the famous 17th-century fortress and former prison. From here, you can spot famous landmarks like the Sagrada Familia and Torre Glòries, as well as take in the beautiful harbor views and start your exploration of Montjuïc highlights.
